notes.title: Update [ver2.0.1]
notes.notes:
*Added piece drawing in 2D or 3D switching function 
  (Fixed problem that tiles not appear in a part of PC that has low video card. )

The above is additional mainly for a part of PC that has low video card. 
If the tiles not drawn in 3D, try playing in 2D. 
(to be selected "2D or 3D" in option screen. )
